next.reason: 1985: "The INVALID KEY phrase must be specified for a DELETE statement which references a file which is not in sequential access mode"; 2023: "the optional INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY phrases in the DELETE RECORD statement (GR-14.9.10.4-11); no SR requires them". 2023 DELETE syntax rules only forbid INVALID KEY in sequential access, and GR-11 calls the phrase optional. The 1985 requirement to code it when no USE procedure applies is dropped.
